question: What bodily and perceptual effects result from this meditative attainment?
premises: Destruction of wrinkles and grey hair is mentioned.
Seeing from very far away is mentioned.
Both are presented as resulting effects.
inference: This attainment brings the destruction of wrinkles and grey hair and the ability to see from very far away.
plain_english: It brings the destruction of wrinkles and grey hair, and likewise the ability to see from very far away.
